init.description: One-command bootstrap: registers @nx-devkit/typescript in nx.json, removes standalone @nx-devkit/* entries, detects config files, adds devDependencies for detected tools, and prints an inferred-targets summary.

monorepo.description: Bootstrap a new Nx monorepo with @nx-devkit/typescript preset and create the first package with inferred targets.

package.description: Add a new package to an existing Nx monorepo with @nx-devkit/typescript preset. Creates package structure with inferred targets.
